statements.text: Prednisolone 30 mg orally once daily for 5 days (10 mL of 50 mg/5 mL solution each morning).

evidence.quote: The dose is one milligram per kilogram, he's 30 kilogram, so prednisolone 30 milligrams once a day for five days. The liquid is 50 milligrams per five milliliters, so that's 10 milliliters each morning.

note.after_visit_summary: Today we saw your child for worsening cough and wheezing that started after a cold. He has been using his albuterol inhaler often but stopped his daily controller medicine. In the clinic, we gave a breathing treatment that helped his breathing and oxygen levels. We diagnosed an asthma flare-up. We started a steroid medicine (prednisolone) to reduce inflammation: give 10 mL by mouth each morning for 5 days. For quick relief, use albuterol inhaler: 4 puffs with spacer every 4 hours while awake for the next 2 days, then only as needed. Restart the daily controller medicine, fluticasone: 2 puffs twice a day, every day, even when he feels well. Have him rinse his mouth after using fluticasone. We updated his asthma action plan and will send a copy to his school nurse. He can return to school when he does not need albuterol more than every 4 hours. Bring him back to the clinic on Friday for a recheck and flu shot. Go to the emergency room if he needs albuterol more than every 4 hours, cannot speak in full sentences, has rib pulling in with breathing, or has bluish lips.
